dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, forming a smooth spline from the apex to the posterior dorsal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with a narrow rounding radius at the highest morphological point of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear slope oriented at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of the fin base width to its vertical height is approximately 1.3:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Pronounced convex arc with a consistent radius defining the forehead profile from the blowhole area to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short rostrum with a visible pixel length approximately half the vertical height of the melon arc.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Clearly defined obtuse angle at the pixel junction where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct dark circular hyper-pigmented spots on the mid-lateral flank and faint linear striations on the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally thin, needle-like projection of the caudal peduncle and a single visible pectoral fin with a convex leading edge.
